design.summary: Robed dark caster in black and magenta with a horned helm and a floating dark orb cupped in one hand.
design.silhouette: Two tall curved horns on a rounded helm, wide bell-shaped robe flaring to the ground, one glowing dark orb held out at hip height.

headgear.description: Round black iron helm with a narrow glowing eye-slit and two thick curved bone horns sweeping up and outward.

armour.description: Black quilted robe front with a magenta sash and a glowing rune clasp.
Magenta cord belt with three small hanging skull charms.
Pointed black boots with magenta toe caps.

design.cloth: Long black robe hem flaring around the legs with a magenta lining; a short black cape with a magenta inner side hangs from the shoulders.
design.weapon_summary: A sphere of near-black glass with a bright magenta rim light, floating just above the right palm.

proportions.style: short wide chibi: big head (about 1/3 of the height), stocky wide torso, short thick limbs, big hands and boots
proportions.notes: Standing height is equal in the down, up and right views. Feet of every frame rest on ONE baseline row.

weapon.name: dark orb
weapon.description: A sphere of near-black glass with a bright magenta rim light, floating just above the right palm.

down.descriptor: FRONT view (down): the figure faces the camera, face and chest visible, both boots visible, toes toward the viewer.

up.descriptor: BACK view (up): the figure faces away from the camera. NO face, NO eyes, NO mouth anywhere: show only the back of the head/headgear, the back of the torso, back armour and the cape/cloth hanging down the back, and the heels of both boots. Back view: two horns from behind, plain helm back with a magenta stripe, cape with a magenta rune on the back, robe hem.

right.descriptor: RIGHT side view (right): a TRUE side profile facing the right edge of the image, body turned exactly 90 degrees, one eye only, nose/brow in profile; the NEAR arm and NEAR leg are drawn IN FRONT of the torso, the far limbs partly hidden behind it.

poses: Stand relaxed, feet shoulder-width apart, the dark orb floating over the right palm, left hand relaxed, chest rests low.
Breathe in: torso rises one pixel step, shoulders lift slightly, the robe hem and cape.
Peak of the breath: head and chest at their highest, arms swing a hair outward, the robe hem and cape sways a little.
Breathe out: torso sinks back lower than frame 1, weight shifts slightly, the robe hem and cape settles.
Contact: left boot planted forward, right boot behind on its toes, arms opposite to legs, the dark orb floating over the right palm, left hand relaxed.
Down: body at its lowest, left boot flat under the body, right boot lifting off, right knee bent.
Passing: right leg swings through beside the planted left leg, body at its highest, the robe hem and cape.
Contact: right boot planted forward, left boot behind on its toes, arms swapped, the dark orb floating over the right palm, left hand relaxed.
Down: body at its lowest, right boot flat under the body, left boot lifting off, left knee bent.
Passing: left leg swings through beside the planted right leg, body at its highest, the robe hem and cape flares.
Wind-up: right arm pulled back at the hip, orb held close, body coiled, horns tilted down.
Step in with the front foot, right arm swinging forward, orb leading, a lunge forward.
Strike: right arm fully extended ahead at chest height, orb at the far end of the arm, robe snapping.
Follow-through: body leaning far forward, orb at the end of the extended arm, left hand flung back.
Recover: arm drawing back, orb returning above the palm, robe settling.
Gather: both hands rise to chest height, the orb floating between them, head bowed.
Orb lifts overhead in the right hand, left hand points at the target, knees bending.
Arms spread wide, orb held high above the horns, chest thrust out, robe flaring upward.
Thrust: both arms snap forward, orb at the end of the right arm far ahead of the body.
Recover: arms lowering, orb dropping back over the right palm, cape settling.
Crouch low, knees bent deeply, head ducked forward, the dark orb floating over the right palm, left hand relaxed pulled in tight.
Launch: body tipping forward, head tucked, back arching, both boots still visible leaving the floor.
Tumble 1: figure curled into a compact ball, head near the knees, back toward the camera side, boots tucked.
Tumble 2: the ball has rotated half a turn, upside down, boots up top, head tucked below.
Tumble 3: rotating up out of the ball, legs reaching down toward the ground, head coming up.
Landing: one knee bent, other boot planted, rising out of the roll, the dark orb floating over the right palm, left hand relaxed back in hand.
Struck: head snaps back, torso leans away from the blow, eyes squeezed shut, arms flung outward, the dark orb floating over the right palm, left hand relaxed.
Recoil: body bent at the waist, knees buckled, one boot sliding back, wincing, the dark orb floating over the right palm, left hand relaxed.
Fatal hit: head snaps back, torso arching, the dark orb floating over the right palm, left hand relaxed loosening in the grip.
Stumble: knees give way, one knee drops, a hand drops the weapon, head hangs.
Fall: body topples sideways, both arms flailing, boots leaving the ground.
Impact: the body lands on its side, weapon clattering beside it, cloth settling.
Slump: the body flat on the ground, one arm stretched out, legs straight, head turned.
Final: lying completely still on the ground, weapon at rest next to the hand, cloth lying flat. Feet on the baseline row.
